description: Many thanks to Johnstown Pride and Keystone Alliance Gay life Newsletter for hosting the Johnstown Pride festival and inviting me to speak. I enjoyed speaking with many voters who worry about their rights to vote, to create the family they choose, to continue to be married to the love of their life. I let them…
